title: Preserving Jobs and Tax Revenue in the Age of AI: Q&A with Carter Price
summary_en: Carter Price, a mathematician at RAND and co-director of the RAND Von Furstenberg Family Budget Model Initiative, discusses ways to rebalance the tax code so that it doesn't incentivize employers to replace humans with AI.
title_cn: Preserving Jobs and Tax Revenue in the Age of AI: Q&A with Carter Price
